## DELETE `/api/instances/hostGroup/name:{name}`

**Tier:** T3  

Delete a host group. All hosts in this host group will be removed from this host group, but these hosts will not be deleted and they will keep their current access to LUNs.

| Parameter | In | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | path | string | yes | Name of the host group. |

_4 parameter(s) have no name in the source spec and are omitted._

**Responses:** `204` No Content
